groups.contract: Living party/readiness enumeration and checked public power aggregation
groups.disposition: Personally analyzed exact P16 body and full PR result-type delta. Living enumeration filters missing/dead Character rows, then sorts; the power fold uses checked count and checked u64 sums with explicit errors. It does not deduplicate membership IDs or require Character.party_id consistency. Actual PartyMember schema uses auto-inc row ID and nonunique party/character indices, so uniqueness remains a writer/aggregate dependency, not a proven invariant from the schema. No ordinary duplicate-producing transition demonstrated here; do not silently use this reader as proof of unique living actors. Public readiness uses actual condition and illness rows; leader membership depends on Party authority admission.

groups.contract: Companion recovery and exact evacuation destination
groups.disposition: Recovery delegates only with not-ready leader and an actually publicly ready companion; start requires off-settlement and exact case-site/journey authority destination, continue requires camp destination equality. No own arithmetic or mutation and no new operation defect. Preserve withdrawn F086 qualification; these helpers are not a new withdrawal restriction finding.

Existing character checks exact current settlement; new character delegates canonical origin creation with deterministic u64 seed, player mode and solo-party/materialized carry options.
